panels.description:
Summary of the security alert including severity, alert rule, affected asset, and the original detection timestamp.
Provides analysts with immediate context about what triggered the alert.
panels.title: Alert Overview

panels.description:
Displays the affected asset and associated user account involved in the alert.
Helps analysts quickly identify the system and account potentially impacted.
panels.title: Asset Context

panels.description:
Maps the alert to the MITRE ATT&CK framework including tactic and technique.
Provides threat intelligence context for the type of adversary behavior detected.
panels.title: Threat Context

panels.description:
Tracks the lifecycle of the alert investigation including assigned analyst,
investigation start time, escalation events, and resolution details.
Also records analyst notes for case documentation.
panels.title: Investigation Workflow

panels.description:
Chronological timeline of key investigation events including alert creation,
investigation start, escalation, false positive marking, and closure.
Provides a clear audit trail of the analyst response process.
panels.title: Investigation Workflow Timeline

panels.description: Displays a chronological log of analyst actions on the alert, including investigation, escalation, closure, and false positive decisions. Each entry shows the analyst, action taken, and investigation note.
panels.title: Analyst Activity Feed

panels.description: Displays the analyst currently responsible for the alert investigation.
panels.title: Case Owner

panels.description:
Displays the current resolution state of the alert such as Investigating,
Escalated, False Positive, or Resolved.
panels.title: Resolution Status

panels.description:
Measures the time between investigation start and escalation to a higher
tier analyst. Used to evaluate how quickly complex alerts are escalated.
panels.title: Escalation Delay

panels.description:
Total time taken from alert creation until final resolution
(closed or marked false positive). This metric helps measure
SOC response efficiency.
panels.title: Time To Resolve
